steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: This sculpture, titled <color=#fb9259>Hidden Arrows</color>, initially took the form of a young woman shot in the back by arrows, implying the fear of hurtful words from others.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: So what do you think of this work, everyone?
Immersed in his own world, Josh completely ignores everything around him. Hella and EMP look at each other, and shrug at the same time.
Silence. A dead silence falls in Belphegor Art Museum.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: ...Looks like you don't have perspectives you'd like to share. I won't keep disturbing your tour, then.
Clap!
Josh suddenly claps his hands, and the sound explodes in the silent museum. EMP jumps to hide behind Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: *****! Damn it, what do you want now?!

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: That was so exciting! I never thought I would one day be able to face a stone shadow! And according to previous records, I must also be the first person to survive AND defeat one!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Wow! No one has ever been able to beat it before? Oh, right, remember how I shot that last arrow? Straight to the head! That was so cool!
EMP jumps out from behind Hella excitedly.

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: The urban legend society will be abuzz for me! If we could meet more thrilling monsters here...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Then they will all taste the arrows of the Archer Queen of Syndicate!

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: Hahaha! Urban legends, come to me!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hahaha!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Stop laughing!
Bearing with the ear-piercing laughter for a while, Hella finally snaps.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: **** you, EMP! Stop laughing like that crazy nerd!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I should smash your heads open and see what kind of crap is inside!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hey, don't push me! Get your hands off!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Don't piss me off, or I won't hesitate to whoop your ass!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I pushed you? Did you catch his stupidity? Use your teeny-tiny brain! How can I push you when I'm walking in front of you?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Then who the **** is pushing me? It can't be the statue, right? The only moving one has been smashed to pieces by us. All the other ones are stuck to the wall with no legs...
They stop in their way, suddenly realizing something.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Wait... Only statues standing on the ground can move, right...?
Hella rushes to cover EMP's mouth, but it's too late. Only empty panels are left on the bleak white walls, and the reliefs have somehow gathered and surrounded them.
One of them wearing a hood has even put her hand on EMP's shoulder.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: A-a-are these the broken one's friends and family...? What should we do?!
EMP cries out, her voice shaking. Hella grumpily scratches her hair.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I gotta find something to stuff into your mouth!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: W-what should we do now...? So many of them...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is there another way out? Grab your bow!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We'll smash them all! What's so scary about a bunch of stones?
